es.citation: Reconocemos el uso de datos e imágenes del Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) de la NASA (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/tools/firms), parte del Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS) de la NASA.
es.warning: Por su resolución espacial, FIRMS no recomienda usar estos datos para decisiones tácticas o a escala local. Este calendario es una herramienta de contexto histórico.

en.citation: We acknowledge the use of data and imagery from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/tools/firms), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
en.warning: Because of their spatial resolution, FIRMS does not recommend these data for tactical or local-scale decisions. This calendar is a tool for historical context.
